name: Mr.MOON LIGHT 2
source:
*Mr.MOON LIGHT2 is a sequel story to Mr.MOON LIGHT.

2 years have passed.
Ryoji and Koichi do not get along with each other well recently for some reasons.
And Koichi decides to leave Ryoji.
Tsujioka tries to fix their relationship, however...

Koichi declares love for Tsujioka.
But the answer was no.
He still suffers from his painful past and prefers to be alone.

Alone, Koichi decides to live for himself and not for someone else,
with a person who he really loves.

And he goes forward.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046993.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
*《月光先生2》是《月光先生》的续集故事。

2年过去了。
由于某些原因，亮司和光一最近相处得不太好。
浩一决定离开亮司。
辻冈试图修复他们的关系，然而……

光一向辻冈表达了爱意。
但答案是否定的。
他仍然受着痛苦的过去的折磨，更喜欢独自一人。

孤身一人的小一决定为自己而活，而不是为别人而活，
和一个他真正爱的人。

他继续前进。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE046993.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
